name: gandalf-quality-gates
description: Run Gandalf's quality gates while you code: inline diagnostics, a findings panel, and the full HTML scorecard inside VS Code.

gandalf.executable.markdownDescription: Path to the `gandalf` wrapper (see `make install`). Empty means auto-detect: `#gandalf.checkoutPath#` → a gandalf checkout in the workspace → `gandalf` on `PATH` → `~/.local/share/gandalf`.

gandalf.checkoutPath.markdownDescription: Path to a gandalf source checkout (the directory containing `src/gandalf`). Used with `#gandalf.pythonPath#` as `python -m gandalf`.

gandalf.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used when running gandalf from a source checkout.

gandalf.configPath.markdownDescription: Path to a `.gandalf.toml` passed as `--config`. Point this at an editor-specific config to run a narrower gate set while you type (gate `only`/`skip` selection lives in the config file, not on the CLI).

gandalf.extraArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments appended to every gandalf invocation.

enumDescriptions: Scan after a file is saved (debounced).
Scan on save, plus a periodic full-workspace sweep.
Only scan when a Gandalf command is invoked.
gandalf.scan.trigger.description: When scans run. Gandalf never scans on keystroke — gates spawn real tools.

gandalf.scan.scopeOnSave.markdownDescription: What a save-triggered scan covers. `file` scopes gandalf to the saved file (`--path`) and is the only cheap option; `workspace` re-runs every gate over the whole tree.

gandalf.scan.debounceMs.description: Quiet period after the triggering event before a scan starts. Later events restart the timer.

gandalf.scan.idleMs.description: Additionally require this many milliseconds without edits before starting a scan. 0 disables the idle check.

gandalf.scan.intervalMinutes.description: Period of the full-workspace sweep for the interval triggers.

gandalf.scan.onStartup.description: Run one full-workspace scan when the window opens, so the panel is populated.

gandalf.scan.timeoutSeconds.description: Kill a gandalf run that exceeds this wall-clock budget.

gandalf.scan.concurrency.markdownDescription: Max gates running at once (`--concurrency`). `0` leaves gandalf's default (CPU count). Lower it to keep the machine responsive — gates spawn `docker run`.

gandalf.scan.useCache.markdownDescription: Pass `--cache` on workspace/staged scans so unchanged gates are reused. File-scoped scans skip the cache on purpose — they would overwrite the workspace entries with a one-file hash.

gandalf.scan.cachePath.markdownDescription: Cache file, relative to the repository root. Add it to `.gitignore`, or use something like `.git/gandalf-cache.json` to keep it out of the tree entirely.

gandalf.scan.llm.markdownDescription: Include the LLM summary in background scans (`--no-llm` is passed when off). The report can always be regenerated with the summary on demand.

gandalf.diagnostics.enabled.description: Publish findings as editor diagnostics (squiggles + hover).

gandalf.diagnostics.minSeverity.description: Lowest finding severity published as a diagnostic.

gandalf.diagnostics.maxPerFile.description: Cap on diagnostics published per file.

gandalf.reports.directory.markdownDescription: Where scan artifacts are written (`--out-dir`). Empty means the extension's own storage, so the repository's `reports/` directory is left alone.

gandalf.reports.keep.description: How many of the extension's own report files to keep before pruning the oldest. Only files this extension wrote are ever removed.

gandalf.reports.recordTrend.markdownDescription: Append editor scans to `.gandalf-trend.jsonl`. Off by default: a scan on every save would swamp the commit-scored history.

gandalf.tools.image.markdownDescription: Docker image that supplies scanner tools that are not on `PATH` (`GANDALF_TOOLS_IMAGE`).

gandalf.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the verdict in the status bar.

gandalf.scan.llmRetries.markdownDescription: `GANDALF_LLM_RETRIES` for editor scans. The skill-backed judge gates call the LLM regardless of `#gandalf.scan.llm#` (that setting only controls the report's summary), and gandalf's default of 3 retries with exponential backoff costs ~7s per call when no endpoint is reachable — measured at 14.4s of a 14.9s scan on gandalf's own repository. `1` retry brings that to 3.3s while still absorbing a transient failure; `0` never retries; `-1` restores gandalf's default.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm test && node esbuild.mjs --production
